name: House Tech Doc
description: The house design system for technical docs (TDDs, specs, persona pages) published as claude.ai HTML artifacts. Default palette comes from the Pulo ng Lamat project tokens (green-tinted neutrals); any project can override it with --project-tokens. Every color is a token with a light and a dark value; text tokens hold at least 4.5:1 against bg, surface, surface-2 and code-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: raised panels: module cards, tables, PR cards, dialogs

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: tinted panel: table header row, nav hover and active entry, meta labels

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: body text and headings (15.1:1 light, 14.6:1 dark on bg)

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: secondary text: captions, labels, nav subsections (6.3:1 light, 7.5:1 dark on bg)

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: hairlines, card and table borders (decorative, not a control edge)

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: control edges (buttons, check boxes) and the table header rule; at least 3:1 on bg

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: links, the active nav number, focus ring (5.2:1 light, 10.9:1 dark on bg)

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: DEFAULT status (running default, owner ruling owed) and .callout.warn

tokens.name: ruled
tokens.usage: RULED status: a solid ink chip; text on it uses bg

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: diagram plate: light in both themes so tldraw strokes and labels stay legible; dimmed in dark to avoid glare

tokens.name: plate-line
tokens.usage: plate border and its drafting grid

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: letterbox behind video and gallery clips: dark in both themes, like the whiteboard film

display.usage: h1, h2, h3, module titles; optical sizing on

mono.usage: code, section and figure numbers, chips, eyebrows, meta values
